decision: accepted exact test module responsibility and fingerprint
rationale: This single regression spec owns the shared synthetic artifact route fixture and its request/receipt controls for both notes and debriefs, plus the directly adjacent saved-artifact caption projection. Tests cover malformed/uncertain receipts, repeat-submission fencing, remount and client replacement, pending input, native operation-specific metadata, and four distinct sharing captions. The added caption case uses the existing private fixture instead of introducing a duplicate server/setup owner. The file is only seven nonblank lines beyond the review threshold, has no function-size signals, adds no production dependency or policy, and keeps the action-specific scenario assertions visible together. The explicitly labeled synthetic debrief share presentation bridge does not qualify the native GET gap; independent native-omission tests qualify truthful unavailable captions separately.
